subject: Review minimal controller succession handoff; no leader-election service
body: Reopened controller/succession design is intentionally minimal: one handoff FSM over existing immutable AgentBus events. Successor must revalidate current Git HEAD, protocol lock/discovery, board delta, unresolved lanes/contradictions, regression/integrity state, and pending human-commit state. controllerEpoch is continuity metadata only and grants no Git authority. Because succession touches authority interpretation, this proposal is not silently made mandatory; review/accept/supersede it under current Manager/Primary controls.
